T = TypeVar("T")

V = TypeVar("V")

    """A node in an AVL tree."""

    __slots__ = ("key", "value", "left", "right", "height")

        self.key: T = key
        self.value: Any = value
        self.left: Optional[AVLNode[T]] = None
        self.right: Optional[AVLNode[T]] = None
        self.height: int = 1


class AVLTree(Generic[T]):
    """
    An AVL (Adelson-Velsky and Landis) self-balancing binary search tree.
    
    All operations (search, insert, delete) run in O(log N) time.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._root: Optional[AVLNode[T]] = None
        self._size: int = 0

    @property
    def size(self) -> int:
        """Return the number of elements in the tree. O(1)."""
        return self._size

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return self._size

    def __contains__(self, key: T) -> bool:
        """Check if a key exists in the tree. O(log N)."""
        return self._search_node(key) is not None

    def _get_height(self, node: Optional[AVLNode[T]]) -> int:
        """Get the height of a node. O(1)."""
        if node is None:
            return 0
        return node.height

    def _get_balance(self, node: Optional[AVLNode[T]]) -> int:
        """Get the balance factor of a node. O(1)."""
        if node is None:
            return 0
        return self._get_height(node.left) - self._get_height(node.right)

    def _update_height(self, node: AVLNode[T]) -> None:
        """Update the height of a node. O(1)."""
        node.height = 1 + max(
            self._get_height(node.left), self._get_height(node.right)
        )

        Perform a right rotation around node z. O(1).
        
        Returns the new root of the rotated subtree.

            raise RuntimeError("Cannot rotate right: left child is None")

        z.left = t3

        self._update_height(z)

        y = z.right

            raise RuntimeError("Cannot rotate left: right child is None")
        t2 = y.left

        # Perform rotation
        y.left = z
        z.right = t2

        # Update heights
        self._update_height(z)
